items.title: James "Sing" Miller Interview, 1971-01-17
items.q: I went out there by Mama Lou with Clayton. ... Kit Clayton.

ctx.x: How much should he charge you for the hot dog? 15 cents for hot dogs. Wow, it took a whole quarter of your night's pay.

And you needed two hot dogs to get full, so I got them with 30 cents. Oh, and then where did you play after that? Well, after that, I went out there by Mama Lou with Clayton. Oh. Out on Lakefront, Kit Clayton. And what year was that?
